step_by_step_reasoning:
The whiteboard depicts two distinct machine learning recommendation architecture patterns used by StockUp (士多): 'User-Item' recommendation on the left and 'Cart-Item' recommendation on the right, both managed behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB) and triggered by CloudWatch Schedule.

1. External Actors: UserConsumerWeb/Mobile sends web/app requests to the ALB.
2. ALB routes requests to ECS on the left (User-Item microservice) or ECS on the right (Cart-Item microservice).
3. Left Column (User-Item Pipeline):
   - CloudWatch Schedule triggers an EC2 instance daily to retrain the ML model.
   - EC2 computes batch recommendations and writes them directly to DynamoDB.
   - ECS (Fargate) handles user requests by fetching premade recommendation results from DynamoDB.
4. Right Column (Cart-Item Pipeline):
   - CloudWatch Schedule triggers an EC2 instance for batch retraining.
   - EC2 uploads the updated model artifact to S3 and signals ECS to perform a rolling redeployment.
   - ECS (Fargate) fetches the updated model from S3 upon starting new container tasks and serves real-time cart recommendations.
